purpose: **LAYERS Index** — Dynamically scanned from repo for all Layer: definitions. Tracks available runtime layers.
notes: Boot layer is ONLY mandatory for initial system boot (cold start). Once booted, control hands off to the dev layer by default for ongoing operation and development. Use /layer casual, /layer roleplay etc. to switch. Currently 6 layers loaded and indexed (more can be added by creating new LAYERS/<name>/<name>.md with '# Layer: /<name>' header). SHA intentionally omitted — local runtime fetches fresh SHA from GitHub API during pulls.
